thread:
ashley.k: hey team - I submitted a cross-pool GPU capacity transfer earlier (resv-id: rsv-8f3b) and the request has been stuck in 'approval' for ~18h. can someone check why it's not progressing?
jonathan.r: looking now. which pools are involved? source was eu-west-1-gpu-v2, dest us-east-1-gpu-pool1?
maria_ops: yeah that's the one. i filed because the eu pool hit 95% and we need burst capacity in us-east for a demo.
ashley.k: correct. demo tomorrow, need ~4x A100 equiv for 2 hours. no hard SLA but would be bad to miss.
infra-ops-bot: [automated] Request rsv-8f3b status: PENDING_APPROVAL. Submitted by ashley.k at 1901231200. Pending approver: ops_lead. Current ETA: unknown.
jonathan.r: ops_lead is OOO until EOD PST per calendar. this flow normally auto-approves if source/dest are same org and cost <= $X, but this one flagged because cross-region chargeback differs.
ashley.k: ah okay. any way to bypass or expedite? demo is customer-facing.
ops_lead: @ashley.k sorry, saw this while catching up. flagged because the cost center on the request is blank and our cross-region billing mapping couldn't find a match. that's why it landed on my queue.
maria_ops: cost code should be ai-demo-2026. i can update the request if that's all.
ops_lead: please update, that'll re-run the cost validation.
ashley.k: i updated the request with ai-demo-2026.
infra-ops-bot: [automated] Request rsv-8f3b status: PENDING_COST_VALIDATION. Run id cv-442.
jonathan.r: cv-442 shows a mismatch: estimated egress charge exceeds threshold for free transfers between org pools. finance needs to OK the extra egress. paging @fin-billing.
fin-billing: thanks for the ping. i see an estimated cross-region egress of $180 for the 2h window due to model checkpoint fetches. can we reduce that footprint (e.g., pre-stage model in dest pool) to avoid charge?
maria_ops: we can pre-pull the model artifact (10GB) to an S3 bucket in us-east and update runtime to use that. would take ~30-40m.
ashley.k: that works. please proceed.
fin-billing: if you pre-stage and confirm, we can waive the manual approval and mark cost delta as approved for this demo. confirm once done.
maria_ops: pre-pull started. command we ran: ```aws s3 cp s3://models/redwood-demo/v2.ckpt s3://us-east-cache/redwood-demo-v2.ckpt --region us-east-1```
maria_ops: pre-pull complete. verified checksum.
infra-ops-bot: [automated] Cost validation passed for rsv-8f3b. Estimated incremental cost: $12 (network + transient infra). Approval auto-granted.
jonathan.r: kicked the transfer job. should start provisioning within the next 5m.
ashley.k: thank you all. can we add a quick postmortem action: add cost center field as required for cross-region transfers so this doesn't block again?
ops_lead: +1. i'll open a follow-up ticket to make cost center required and add an optional pre-stage checkbox that triggers a small checklist for artifacts.
fin-billing: also proposing an auto-approve threshold for demo/marketing tags up to $200 in egress — will draft a policy.
ashley.k: sounds good.
infra-ops-bot: [automated] Request rsv-8f3b status: COMPLETED. GPUs migrated and allocation confirmed.
